specimen--noun.def: A single example of something, studied or collected.
specimen--noun.ex: The lab tested a soil specimen.
specimen--noun.exTr: Laboratuvar bir toprak numunesini test etti.

hypocrite--noun.def: A person who says one thing and does another.
hypocrite--noun.ex: Nobody likes being called a hypocrite.

apprentice--noun.def: A young person learning a trade from a skilled worker.
apprentice--noun.ex: He started as an apprentice at sixteen.

apprentice--verb.def: To place someone with a skilled worker to learn a trade.
apprentice--verb.ex: His father apprenticed him to a smith.
apprentice--verb.exTr: Babası onu bir demirciye çırak verdi.

intuition--noun.def: The ability to understand something without reasoning.

bypass--verb.def: To avoid something by going around it.
bypass--verb.ex: The new road bypasses the village.

insecure--adj.def: Lacking confidence, or not safe and stable.
insecure--adj.ex: The job left him feeling insecure.

heroine--noun.def: The main female character, or a woman admired for courage.
heroine--noun.ex: The heroine refuses to give up.

plumbing--noun.def: The system of pipes that carries water in a building.

crude--adj.def: In a natural unprocessed state, or rough and unfinished.
crude--adj.ex: They built a crude shelter from branches.

demo--noun.def: A short recording or a display showing how something works.
demo--noun.ex: The band sent out a demo.

revealing--adj.def: Showing something that was hidden or not known.

gadget--noun.def: A small clever tool or device.
gadget--noun.ex: The kitchen is full of gadgets.

recess--noun.def: A break in a court or a parliament, or a space set into a wall.
recess--noun.ex: Parliament is in recess until autumn.

speculation--noun.def: Guessing about something without firm evidence.
speculation--noun.ex: The report ended weeks of speculation.

saloon--noun.def: A public bar, or a car with a separate boot.
saloon--noun.ex: The old saloon still has its wooden bar.
saloon--noun.exTr: Eski barda hâlâ ahşap tezgâh duruyor.

clinical--adj.def: Relating to treating patients, or cold and without feeling.
clinical--adj.ex: The drug passed its clinical trials.

prop--verb.def: To support something so it does not fall.
prop--verb.ex: He propped the door open with a brick.

prop--noun.def: A support, or an object used by actors on stage.
prop--noun.ex: The sword is only a prop.

tread--noun.def: The pattern on a tyre, or the sound of steps.
tread--noun.ex: The tread on these tyres is worn.

precision--noun.def: The quality of being exact and accurate.

batter--verb.def: To hit someone or something repeatedly and hard.

batter--noun.def: A liquid mixture of flour and eggs used in cooking.
batter--noun.ex: Dip the fish in the batter.

cloak--noun.def: A loose coat with no sleeves, or something that hides.
cloak--noun.ex: He wore a heavy woollen cloak.

quarry--noun.def: A place where stone is cut out of the ground.
quarry--noun.ex: The quarry closed twenty years ago.
quarry--noun.exTr: Taş ocağı yirmi yıl önce kapandı.

circulation--noun.def: The movement of blood in the body, or the number of copies sold.

remotely--adv.def: From a distance, or in the slightest degree.

privileged--adj.def: Having special advantages that others do not have.

dependent--noun.def: A person who relies on someone else for money.
dependent--noun.ex: He has two dependents at home.
dependent--noun.exTr: Evde bakmakla yükümlü olduğu iki kişi var.

charter--verb.def: To hire a plane, a bus or a boat for private use.

charter--noun.def: An official document setting out rights and aims.

cynical--adj.def: Believing that people act only from selfish motives.

purity--noun.def: The state of being clean and not mixed with anything.
purity--noun.ex: They tested the purity of the water.

debut--noun.ex: She made her debut at twenty.

debut--verb.def: To appear or be shown in public for the first time.

fossil--noun.def: The remains of an animal or a plant preserved in rock.
fossil--noun.ex: They found a fossil in the cliff.

stretching--noun.def: Exercises that make your muscles longer and looser.

clutch--verb.def: To hold something tightly, often from fear.
clutch--verb.ex: She clutched the rail as the boat rolled.
clutch--verb.exTr: Tekne sallanırken korkuluğu sıkı sıkı tuttu.

clutch--noun.def: The pedal that connects the engine to the wheels.

fusion--noun.def: The joining of two things into one.
fusion--noun.ex: The music is a fusion of two traditions.

paddle--verb.def: To move a small boat with a paddle, or to walk in shallow water.
paddle--verb.ex: We paddled up the river at dawn.

traumatic--adj.def: Causing a lasting shock to the mind.

fiddle--verb.def: To touch or move something restlessly with your fingers.

fiddle--noun.def: A violin, especially in folk music.
fiddle--noun.ex: He played the fiddle at weddings.

credibility--noun.def: The quality of being believed and trusted.

insensitive--adj.def: Not noticing or caring about others' feelings.

wrench--verb.def: To pull something suddenly and violently.

accustomed--adj.def: Used to something because of long experience.
accustomed--adj.ex: She is accustomed to early starts.

bulk--noun.def: The main part of something, or great size.
bulk--noun.ex: The bulk of the work is done.

plaster--noun.def: The soft material spread on walls, or a small bandage.
plaster--noun.ex: The plaster is cracking near the window.

plaster--verb.def: To cover a wall with plaster, or to cover a surface thickly.
plaster--verb.ex: They plastered the ceiling last week.

sentiment--noun.ex: Public sentiment turned against the plan.

withdrawn--adj.def: Very quiet and not wanting to be with others.
withdrawn--adj.ex: He became withdrawn after the loss.

isolate--verb.def: To keep a person or a thing apart from others.

marvel--verb.def: To be filled with surprise and admiration.

offspring--noun.def: The young of a person, an animal or a plant.
offspring--noun.ex: The pair raise two offspring each year.
offspring--noun.exTr: Çift her yıl iki yavru büyütüyor.

eccentric--adj.def: Behaving in a strange but harmless way.

eccentric--noun.def: A person who behaves in an unusual way.

liaison--noun.def: Communication between two groups working together.
liaison--noun.ex: She acts as liaison between the teams.

peacock--noun.def: A large bird whose male has a bright spreading tail.

sauna--noun.def: A hot room where people sit to sweat and relax.
sauna--noun.ex: The hotel has a small sauna.

terrain--noun.def: Land of a particular physical kind.
terrain--noun.ex: The terrain is rocky and steep.

ingenious--adj.def: Clever and original in solving a problem.
ingenious--adj.ex: It is an ingenious little device.

salvage--verb.def: To save something from a wreck or a disaster.

premier--adj.def: Best or most important of its kind.
premier--adj.ex: It is the premier hotel in the city.

premier--noun.def: The head of government in some countries.

parasite--noun.def: A living thing that feeds on another and harms it.

phenomenal--adj.ex: The team had a phenomenal season.

maneuver--verb.def: To move something carefully into a tight space.
maneuver--verb.ex: He maneuvered the lorry into the yard.

maneuver--noun.def: A careful movement, or a clever planned action.
maneuver--noun.ex: It was a clever political maneuver.

portable--adj.def: Light enough to be carried and used anywhere.

portable--noun.def: A machine light enough to carry, such as a small television.

honk--verb.def: To sound a car horn, or to make a noise like a goose.
honk--verb.ex: Do not honk outside the hospital.

honk--noun.def: The loud short sound of a horn.

sarcastic--adj.def: Saying the opposite of what you mean in order to mock.

awe--verb.def: To fill someone with deep respect and wonder.

extortion--noun.def: The crime of getting money by threats.

usher--noun.def: A person who shows people to their seats.
usher--noun.ex: An usher led us to row four.
usher--noun.exTr: Bir yer gösterici bizi dördüncü sıraya götürdü.
